note: Level 5 user wallet list for reviewer validation. Liwanag charity transparency board cohort (escrow + on-chain spend ledger).

token.note: Native XLM Stellar Asset Contract — default campaign token, no trustline.

participants.name: Emily Carter
participants.feedback: The thermometer number on a campaign page is the most honest thing I have seen in a fundraising app.

participants.name: Daniel Kim
participants.feedback: Connecting with Freighter took longer than I expected because I had to read the SEP-10 challenge first.

participants.name: Sophia Rossi
participants.feedback: The trustline helper for USDC was a lifesaver — I never had to copy an issuer address by hand.

participants.name: Noah Evans
participants.feedback: When I signed an open_campaign invoke, I would like a one-line preview of the campaign id that will be stored on chain.

participants.name: Olivia Chen
participants.feedback: The donate flow felt snappy and the receipt showed the campaign raised amount update live.

participants.name: James Wilson
participants.feedback: The disburse confirmation card should show the memo hash alongside the recipient address and amount.

participants.name: Mia Taylor
participants.feedback: The on-chain spend ledger is the part of the app I trust the most — every row links back to a Stellar transaction.

participants.name: Lucas Anderson
participants.feedback: I want a dark mode variant of the campaign board and stats page.

participants.name: Sarah Mitchell
participants.feedback: Switching networks in Freighter should not require me to reconnect, but it currently does.

participants.name: Michael Brown
participants.feedback: The campaign row on the browse page should surface the asset (XLM or USDC) next to the goal.

participants.name: Rachel Green
participants.feedback: Mobile layout for the donate card is fine but the approve button sits a bit close to the heading.

participants.name: Ethan Moore
participants.feedback: When a campaign is closed, I want a clear badge on the browse page so donors do not land on a dead board.

participants.name: Hannah Lewis
participants.feedback: The first contribution took me through several steps; a short tooltip on the SEP-10 challenge would help.

participants.name: Benjamin Hayes
participants.feedback: The XLM Stellar Asset Contract default makes sense — no trustline noise for native XLM campaigns.

participants.name: Ava Martinez
participants.feedback: Receipt success page should include a copy-link to the on-chain transaction on Stellar Expert.

participants.name: William Scott
participants.feedback: I want to see my cumulative donations across all campaigns, not just the running total on one page.

participants.name: Isabella Garcia
participants.feedback: The stats page is honest about demo wallets and I appreciate that it does not inflate the counts.

participants.name: Henry Thompson
participants.feedback: When the disburse preview pops up, the recipient address should be clickable to verify on Stellar Expert.

participants.name: Charlotte Adams
participants.feedback: Network pinning to testnet saved me — my Freighter was on a different network and the auth still worked.

participants.name: Alexander Reed
participants.feedback: The Enable USDC button should clarify the trustline is a separate Stellar transaction, not part of the donation.

participants.name: Amelia Walsh
participants.feedback: When my donate invoke succeeds, I would like a one-line breakdown: amount, fee, recipient contract, raised-after.

participants.name: Samuel Cooper
participants.feedback: The character counter on a campaign description is helpful.

participants.name: Victoria Hughes
participants.feedback: I want a filter on the spend ledger so I can see only payouts to a specific recipient.

participants.name: Joseph Ramirez
participants.feedback: The on-chain thermometer lagged slightly when I refreshed — a small skeleton loader would help.

participants.name: Zoe Phillips
participants.feedback: The campaign id on chain being sha256 of the UUID is a clever trick; it would be nice to see the raw hash in the admin panel.

participants.name: David Bell
participants.feedback: Recipient payout address validation should warn if the address fails the Friendbot format check.

participants.name: Grace Peterson
participants.feedback: The donate confirm modal should clearly show the campaign organizer wallet in case donors want to verify it.

participants.name: Andrew Murphy
participants.feedback: The spend-ledger table could use a small CSV export button for reviewers.

participants.name: Lily Sanders
participants.feedback: The first time I connected, I was unsure whether Freighter would sign the challenge automatically.

participants.name: Christopher Diaz
participants.feedback: The campaign board on mobile feels a little tight when the goal and raised values are stacked.

participants.name: Natalie Brooks
participants.feedback: A short explainer of why donations are escrowed by a Soroban contract rather than a hot wallet would help non-crypto users.

participants.name: Ryan Foster
participants.feedback: When a campaign hits its goal, I want a celebratory state on the campaign page, not just a raised-equals-goal row.

participants.name: Hannah Ortiz
participants.feedback: The fee-funded testnet wallets on the landing page are a nice touch.

participants.name: Keith Watson
participants.feedback: I would like a one-click "verify on Stellar Expert" link next to each spend-ledger row.

participants.name: Megan Sanchez
participants.feedback: After donating, the receipt should show the on-chain raised total with the campaign id in the URL.

participants.name: Patrick Reyes
participants.feedback: The admin role needs a clearer separation between creating a campaign and editing the description.

participants.name: Olivia Price
participants.feedback: The donor amount per wallet on chain is a great detail — surface it on my account view.

participants.name: Brandon Long
participants.feedback: Disburse needs an extra confirmation step — the Freighter popup alone is not enough to prevent mistakes.

participants.name: Sofia Mitchell
participants.feedback: When I donate via mobile, the Freighter extension opens a new tab and I lose my scroll position.

participants.name: Jared Stone
participants.feedback: The on-chain receipt page should link to both the donation tx and the resulting campaign state.

participants.name: Kaitlyn Park
participants.feedback: I want to see which organizer wallet receives the disburse before I sign — that should be on the confirmation card.

participants.name: Trevor Owens
participants.feedback: The sign-challenge step from SEP-10 felt opaque until I read the docs.

participants.name: Vanessa Cole
participants.feedback: The campaign board polls the contract every few seconds; the timing feels right but I would like a manual refresh too.

participants.name: Marcus Webb
participants.feedback: A small badge that says "escrowed by Soroban contract" near the raised total would build donor trust.

participants.name: Elena Vargas
participants.feedback: I want to be able to withdraw a campaign before any donations arrive, in case I created it by mistake.

participants.name: Joel Armstrong
participants.feedback: When the disburse invoke succeeds, the spend ledger should highlight the new row for a few seconds.

participants.name: Sabrina Rhodes
participants.feedback: The Trustline helper should warn me about the base reserve before I sign.

participants.name: Derek Patel
participants.feedback: For organizers, a payout history view grouped by campaign would be cleaner than the global spend ledger.

participants.name: Naomi Jenkins
participants.feedback: I would like a hover tooltip on the campaign thermometer that explains what the raised number is sourced from.

participants.name: Calvin Ford
participants.feedback: The recipient address in the disburse modal should be checked against the campaign organizer — flag mismatches.

participants.name: Brandon Long
participants.feedback: Onboarding copy is friendly but the fee disclosure comes too late — flag it on the form, not on confirm.

participants.name: Andrew Murphy
participants.feedback: Dashboard loads fast on mobile but the breakdown labels collapse below 360px — make them two-line wrap.

participants.name: Joseph Ramirez
participants.feedback: Friendbot funded in 2s on first try; second stream needed a manual reset. Recover is acceptable but surprising.

participants.name: Mia Taylor
participants.feedback: Wallet context switches too aggressive — I lost the destination address when I swapped from testnet to a sibling panel.

participants.name: Derek Patel
participants.feedback: CSV export matches what I see on screen; reviewer-friendly. Add a checksum column for the SHA256 of the payload.

participants.name: Alexander Reed
participants.feedback: Role selector defaults to the first option. Most reviewers are not senders — flip the default to the safest role.

participants.name: Patrick Reyes
participants.feedback: Tx hash links work in the explorer; please also show the fee charged so I can audit cost per action.

participants.name: James Wilson
participants.feedback: Rate limit messaging is unclear. Tell me explicitly: how many calls per minute, and on which endpoint.

participants.name: Calvin Ford
participants.feedback: Form validation rejects spaces in label field silently. Show inline error, not toast that disappears.

participants.name: Olivia Price
participants.feedback: Empty state should explain how to continue, not just say "no data". Add the next-action CTA right there.

participants.name: Brandon Long
participants.feedback: The charity transparency board should show every donation on a single timeline, not paginated — the whole story is the point.

participants.name: Andrew Murphy
participants.feedback: Donor anonymity toggle is good, but the on-chain proof still shows the wallet — add a true anonymous mode with zero-knowledge.

participants.name: Joseph Ramirez
participants.feedback: Charity verification status should be visible on the donation button, not two scrolls down.

participants.name: Mia Taylor
participants.feedback: Recurring donation cancellation is too easy — add a 1-second hold to prevent late-night impulse-cancel.

participants.name: Derek Patel
participants.feedback: Charity admin should not be able to spend funds without a board vote — even for small amounts.

participants.name: Alexander Reed
participants.feedback: The donation receipt PDF should include a QR code linking to the on-chain proof — accountants love this.

participants.name: Patrick Reyes
participants.feedback: Cause selection during donation is a dropdown — make it a searchable list with categories and a "popular" badge.

participants.name: James Wilson
participants.feedback: Multi-cause split (50% to water, 50% to education) should be a one-click feature, not a manual flow.

participants.name: Calvin Ford
participants.feedback: Donor leaderboard for a cause should default to opt-in — privacy first.

participants.name: Olivia Price
participants.feedback: Charity campaign end date should be visible, and post-end donations should auto-route to similar live causes.
